about: one textured picture in three one-second worlds under a hard cut. World 1: the picture pans 120 css px to the right (linear). World 2: it zooms from 1 to 1.3 about the centre. World 3: it turns 12 degrees clockwise about the centre. Pan is in video pixels of the 960 px draft (half the css px). World 4: a still slab of rectangles and type, tilted 8 degrees clockwise (a layout that is turned, not a camera that moves).
